todo.NEEDS_REVIEW: Plant X is confirming a few fields that were hard to read on your document. No action needed.
todo.QTY_EXCEEDS_GR: You billed {{excess}} {{uom}} more {{item}} than Plant X has received. Send the remaining goods, or upload a credit note for ₹{{credit}}.
todo.PRICE_VARIANCE: The unit price for {{item}} is above the agreed PO price (₹{{po_price}}). Upload a credit note for ₹{{credit}} or contact your buyer.
todo.MISSING_GR: Waiting for Plant X stores to record receipt of {{item}}. Nothing for you to do: Duly re-checks your invoice automatically.
todo.MISSING_SES: Waiting for Plant X to confirm the service for {{item}} was completed. Nothing for you to do.
todo.BANK_MISMATCH: The bank details on this invoice differ from the account Plant X has on record. For your safety we only pay the verified account. To change it, send a bank change request; Plant X will call you to confirm.
todo.TAX_MISMATCH: The GST on this invoice does not match the rules (for example IGST charged on a supply within the same state). Please send a corrected invoice.
todo.MATH_ERROR: The amounts on this invoice do not add up. Please send a corrected invoice.
todo.NO_PO: This invoice does not quote a valid Plant X purchase order number. Please send it again with the PO number.
todo.PO_CLOSED: The purchase order on this invoice is closed. Please contact your buyer.
todo.GSTIN_INVALID: The GSTIN printed on this invoice failed validation. Please check it and send a corrected invoice.
todo.SUPPLIER_MISMATCH: This invoice's GSTIN does not match the supplier on the purchase order. Please check the PO number.
todo.BILL_TO_MISMATCH: This invoice is not addressed to Plant X Polymers Pvt Ltd's GSTIN. Please correct the bill-to details.
todo.LINE_NOT_ON_PO: An item on this invoice is not on the purchase order. Please check the item codes.
todo.NO_LINES: We could not read the line items. Please upload a clearer copy.
todo.INVOICE_NO_INVALID: The invoice number must be at most 16 characters (letters, digits, / and -).
todo.DATE_INVALID: The invoice date is not acceptable (in the future or too old). Please check it.
todo.SES_VALUE_EXCEEDED: You billed more for {{item}} than the service value Plant X has accepted so far.
todo.PAYMENT_TERMS_MISMATCH: Plant X is checking the payment terms on the order. No action needed.
todo.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The invoice currency differs from the purchase order. Please send it in the PO currency.
todo.default: Plant X needs to check this invoice ({{code}}).
